class.name: DisWarfarePdu
class.brief_description: Shared base of the Fire and Detonation PDUs (protocol family 2, Warfare).
class.description: DisWarfarePdu holds the fields [DisFirePdu] and [DisDetonationPdu] have in common: the entity IDs involved, the event ID that ties a Fire PDU to its Detonation PDU, where the event happened, the munition's velocity, and the munition descriptor ([member munition_type], [member warhead], [member fuse], [member quantity], [member rate]). Its protocol family is 2. All positions and velocities are in the world frame: [member location_ecef] is WGS84 geocentric (ECEF) in metres, [member velocity] is in metres per second. [DisGeoOrigin] converts between ECEF and local scene coordinates. It has no PDU type of its own and cannot be encoded or decoded; use [DisFirePdu] or [DisDetonationPdu].

members.member: Event ID as a [Vector3i] ([code]x[/code] = site, [code]y[/code] = application, [code]z[/code] = event number). The Fire PDU and the Detonation PDU of the same engagement carry the same event ID.
Entity ID of the entity that fired the munition as a [Vector3i] ([code]x[/code] = site, [code]y[/code] = application, [code]z[/code] = entity number).
Fuse code of the munition descriptor (16-bit, SISO-REF-010 "Fuse"). 0 is "Other".

Location of the event in WGS84 geocentric (ECEF) coordinates, as a [PackedFloat64Array] [code][x, y, z][/code] in metres. For a Fire PDU this is where the weapon was fired, for a Detonation PDU where the munition detonated. Kept in doubles because [Vector3] is 32-bit. Setting an array that does not have exactly 3 values prints an error and leaves the old value.

Entity ID of the munition. In a [DisFirePdu] this is the munition or expendable ID; in a [DisDetonationPdu] it is the exploding entity ID. The entity ID is a [Vector3i] ([code]x[/code] = site, [code]y[/code] = application, [code]z[/code] = entity number).

Entity type of the munition as 7 integers: kind, domain, country, category, subcategory, specific, extra (SISO-REF-010 entity type enumeration). Setting an array that does not have exactly 7 values prints an error and leaves the old value.
Quantity of the munition descriptor: the number of munitions fired or detonated together (16-bit).
Rate of the munition descriptor (16-bit): the rate of fire in rounds per minute.
Entity ID of the target, if any as a [Vector3i] ([code]x[/code] = site, [code]y[/code] = application, [code]z[/code] = entity number).
Velocity of the munition in metres per second in the world (ECEF) frame. Stored as 32-bit floats on the wire.
Warhead code of the munition descriptor (16-bit, SISO-REF-010 "Warhead"). 0 is "Other".
